question: How many people were killed in the bus accident in Döşemealtı, Antalya Province in February 2026?

steps.content: [2026 in Turkey] Individuals and events related to 2026 in Turkey.

1 February – A bus falls off a highway embankment in Döşemealtı, Antalya Province, killing nine people and injuring 21 others.
6 February – Nevin Efe, 78, actress (Valley of the Wolves: Ambush, Aşk ve Ceza, Arka Sokaklar).

In the bus accident in Döşemealtı, Antalya Province, on February 1, 2026, nine people were killed and 21 others were injured. 

FINAL: 9 people were killed.
